audit.why: Emerald+ 53.97% over 4234 games. Darius owns levels 1-5, Mordekaiser's only lane swing is Realm of Death at 6, then scaling after two items — the existing early/mid/late split already says this.

audit.whatIsWrong: The Level 6 chart entry contained a leaked LaTeX formula ('R = d + a 	imes Stacks') and never mentioned Mordekaiser's ultimate, which is the actual level-6 spike in this lane.
audit.why: Realm of Death is 140/120/100s versus Noxian Guillotine's 120/100/80s, so the spike is asymmetric: he ults first and you answer on his cooldown.
audit.corrected: Level 6 why rewritten: true-damage point kept, formula leak removed, the 140s-vs-120s ultimate race stated.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction was never stated: Obliterate deals increased damage when it hits a single enemy, and Realm of Death is a 1v1 by definition, so inside it every Obliterate lands isolated. Outside it, standing in the wave cuts that same damage.
audit.why: Riot's Obliterate text: 'Damage is increased when hitting a single enemy.' Realm of Death drags one victim to a different dimension.
audit.corrected: Level 3-5 and Level 6 spike text now state the isolation rule on both sides of it, with Obliterate's 8s rank-1 cooldown as the walk-up cue and Darkness Rise's 3-hit ramp as the leave-cue.

audit.whatIsWrong: The cooldown block carried no numbers at all — 'matchup-defining' and 'Long early cooldown' for Realm of Death and Apprehend respectively.
audit.why: Realm of Death 140/120/100s, Death's Grasp 16/14/12/10/8s, Apprehend 26s at rank 1. The numbers are what make 'fight on his cooldown' actionable.
audit.corrected: Cooldown block now carries the real values and notes his pull returns long before his ultimate does.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two entries had bodies copy-pasted from the trading block that did not match their own headings: 'Dodge his Q' described a pull trade, and 'Extend through his passive' described whiffing Apprehend.
audit.why: The headings promise Obliterate mechanics and Darkness Rise/Indestructible mechanics; the bodies delivered neither.
audit.corrected: Both bodies replaced with the mechanic the heading names, including Indestructible banking damage dealt to it into a shield he can heal off.

edits.before: Before Mordekaiser stacks his Q Obliterate and passive Darkness Rise, your walk-up wins: E Apprehend when his Q is down, W Crippling Strike, and Q the outer blade — his slow, telegraphed Q is easy to sidestep and he has no dash to escape your Hemorrhage rotation.
edits.after: Obliterate does increased damage to a single target, so fight beside your minions and it lands for a fraction. It is 8s at rank 1 — walk up on that cooldown, E Apprehend, W Crippling Strike, Q the outer blade. Darkness Rise needs 3 hits and he has no dash out of your bleed.

edits.before: Morde's R Realm of Death drags you into a 1v1 death realm where his Darkness Rise stacking and stolen stats favor him; avoid giving him the ult by not overextending, because inside it his sustained magic damage out-duels your bleed.
edits.after: Realm of Death is 140s at rank 1 and is a 1v1 by definition — no wave to share it, so every Obliterate lands isolated for its increased damage. Don't stand in kill range while it's up; once he spends it you own two minutes of lane.

edits.before: Noxian Guillotine deals true damage R = d + a \times Stacks, bypassing defensive items completely. The execute resets on takedowns — all-in windows are now real kill windows.
edits.after: Noxian Guillotine is true damage scaled by Hemorrhage stacks, so his shield and armour do nothing. But Realm of Death is 140s to your 120s — he ults first, and you answer on his cooldown.

edits.before: Pull Mordekaiser as he steps to last-hit, W slow, land the Q outer ring, weave two autos, and walk away at 3-4 stacks with the heal banked.
edits.after: Obliterate is 675-range with a wind-up and hits a lone target hardest — stay in the minions, step sideways as he swings, then punish the 8s gap.

edits.before: Whiffing Apprehend and then fighting anyway — without the pull you have no engage, and chasing through a wave bleeds you dry.
edits.after: Darkness Rise ramps after 3 hits and Indestructible banks the damage you deal into a shield he heals off — leave before it pays out.

edits.before: - Mordekaiser Realm of Death: matchup-defining — His isolation 1v1. While it’s down, you win. Darius E (Apprehend): Long early cooldown. Never throw this out predictably; save it explicitly to interrupt their dash trajectories mid-flight or catch their retreat paths. Darius Ghost: Your primary lethal enabler. Keep this tool ready to completely blow through ranged poke or instant slows across the lane.
edits.after: - Mordekaiser Realm of Death: 140/120/100s and it decides the lane — while it is down you win the 1v1 outright. Death's Grasp is 16s at rank 1, so his pull returns long before his ultimate does. Darius E (Apprehend): 26s at rank 1 — never throw it predictably; hold it for his step-up or his retreat. Darius Ghost: your lethal enabler, kept ready to blow through poke or slows and finish the run-down.

notes: Darius kit file flags E Apprehend as 'knockup'; Riot's description says it pulls enemies to him — trusting the description. MC_WR_TABLES.darius.mordekaiser (53.97) matches the packet.
